author: Tunahan Ali Ozturk
name: Relevox request, handler and test
description: A request and its handler in the application project, and a test for the handler in its test project. Run it in the folder that holds both, the layout relevox-webapi creates.

app.description: The application project, the folder and namespace that get the request and its handler. The test goes to <app>.Tests.

response.description: The type the handler answers with. Use none for a request with no response (IRequest).
